commands.description: Agent commands to show in the quick panel. If more than one item is provided, the quick panel will show for selecting the agent.

title.description: Display name for the agent in the quick panel.

cmd.description: Command or executable to spawn as the agent subprocess.

auth.description: Whether the agent requires authentication. When false, skips auth prompts.

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to the agent subprocess.

model.description: Model identifier to use with the agent (e.g. 'custom:OpenRouter-0').

folders.description: Folder names to exclude from @-file completions.

extensions.description: File extensions to exclude from @-file completions.

actions.description: Custom quick actions shown in the prompt panel.

title.description: Label displayed in the quick panel.

prompt.description: Prompt text sent to the agent when this action is selected.

system_prompt.description: Custom system prompt prepended to every agent conversation.

attach_selection.description: Automatically attach the current selection as context (@path:line-line or a code block).

turn_dividers.description: Append markdown dividers (---) after each user prompt and agent reply.

font_size.description: Font size (in points) applied to the ACP scratch output views. null = use the global font size.

context_usage.description: Show context token usage in the status bar (e.g. ctx 27% (53k/200k)).

oneOf.description: Git-based 'Changed files' summary after each agent turn: 'diff' for filenames + per-file diff fences, 'counts' for filenames with change counts only.
Disable the git turn summary entirely.

thoughts.description: How agent thought chunks (thinking...) are surfaced: 'enabled' renders in output as blockquotes, 'disabled' drops them.

tool_calls.description: How agent tool call results are surfaced: 'enabled' renders each completed/failed tool call as a one-line markdown bullet, 'disabled' hides them.

session_list_limit.description: Maximum sessions shown by 'ACP: Switch Session' (session/list).

session_replay_on_switch.description: Replay full conversation history into the output view when switching sessions (via session/load). false = only show a 'switched' notice.

daemon_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-terminating the daemon. 0 = disabled.

timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds: how long to wait for the agent to produce any output before the turn is timed out and cancelled. The clock resets on any agent activity.

permission_prompt_timeout.description: Hard cap in seconds for an open permission prompt. After this the prompt is denied and the turn continues. 0 = wait forever.

cache_ttl.description: Seconds before @-file completions and agent-info caches expire. 0 = always refresh.

permissions.description: Permission control for agent tool calls and host-fs operations.

auto_allow.description: Glob patterns for tool call kinds to auto-approve (e.g. 'read*'). fs/read_text_file maps to kind 'read_file'; fs/write_text_file maps to kind 'write_file'.

auto_reject.description: Glob patterns for tool call kinds to auto-reject. Takes priority over auto_allow.

debug.description: Enable debug logging to the dedicated ACP Log output panel (View > Output; never auto-shown).
